name: EPIC 248744892
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.8 solar radii and 0.76 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,883 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.76 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,898 K at its surface.
